rooms.name: River Ivlis Crossroads
rooms.desc: A trampled circle of bare dirt where three roads meet, hoof-churned, with two black puddles standing in the wagon ruts. A cold wind pours down from the high ground to the west. On a rock knoll above the western forks an old gallows creaks, its frayed rope swinging; across the road a three-armed signpost; behind it, downhill, a low broken wall round a plot of graves lying in fog.
rooms.dm: Roll for a random encounter on arrival unless Vistani escort the party (p.35): 18+ on a d20 on a road, then d12+d8 on the day or night table (p.28-29); a Grave result (4) plays as the open grave turned violated. Escorted parties get no roll and are led down the NW fork to the Tser Pool camp (G). The Hanged One appears the moment they leave by any road (see the gallows). East: the stone bridge about 2.4 road-miles (50 min on foot), the village 3.5 road-miles (just over an hour). NW: the Tser Pool camp, 1.7 mi, 35 min, the last half a muddy rutted track. SW: the Tser Falls bridge (H), about 6 road-miles climbing nearly 600 ft, 2 hours.

rooms.name: Graveyard
rooms.desc: A plot of eleven blank headstones behind a low dry-stone wall that stands only on the north and west; the east side has fallen to a course or two and its stones lie tumbled downslope. The old row has sunk into the turf and leans east; the newer row stands upright. One stone stands apart under a black yew in the corner. A twelfth grave lies open and empty, a rusted shovel in its spoil. Knee-deep fog lies inside the wall and pools in the hollow beyond it.
rooms.dm: All eleven were hanged on the gallows and forgotten; each holds a rotted coffin and mouldy bones 5 ft down. Digging one takes about an hour with the lean-to's tools, twice that bare-handed. If the Tarokka reading put a treasure here (7 of Coins, p.14), each grave dug adds a cumulative 10% chance (p.36); default it to the grave apart. The grave apart under the yew is Marya's lover, hanged for a poisoning Endorovich committed (crypt 7, p.87). The fog is heavily obscured at ground level for prone or Small creatures, lightly obscured otherwise; the sunken hollows are difficult terrain while fogged. The yew's hollow hides one Small creature and a rotted leather bundle (Hidden Bundle, p.30).

objects.label: Gallows knoll
objects.desc: A blunt hump of grey bedrock, flat on top and eight feet above the road at its east face, with thin turf and lichen on its crown. The gallows stands on it against the sky.

objects.label: The gallows
objects.desc: Old wooden gallows on a rotting platform five feet high, its stairs facing the junction. The beam is worn in a groove where many ropes have run; a frayed rope swings from it and creaks in the wind. Two deck planks have rotted through, and a trapdoor with a rusted bolt sits under the rope.

objects.label: Under the platform
objects.desc: Drifted needles, two planks fallen from the deck, a broken short ladder and a coil of old rope gone green.

objects.label: Stair down the rock
objects.desc: A rickety timber stair descends the knoll's east face to the churned ground where the hangman's cart turned.

objects.label: Cart ruts
objects.desc: Two cart ruts, deeper than the road's, leave the apron and end in a churned turn-round at the foot of the stair.

objects.label: Wind-flagged pine
objects.desc: A pine with boughs only on its east side, its trunk leaning away from the wind and bleached bare on the windward face.

objects.label: Wind-flagged pine
objects.desc: A pine with boughs only on its east side, its trunk leaning away from the wind and bleached bare on the windward face.

objects.label: The hearth stone
objects.desc: A rounded grey block twelve feet across. Its east side is smeared with soot, and fish bones lie in the ashes of a small fire someone sheltered here out of the wind.

objects.label: The wedge stone
objects.desc: A wedge of grey rock fifteen feet long lying along the bank of the climbing road, lichen on its north face.

objects.label: Signpost
objects.desc: A weathered fingerpost with three arms, its lettering chipped: Barovia Village east, Tser Pool north-west, Ravenloft and Vallaki south-west. Reading it means facing the noose across the road.

objects.label: The first dip of the Tser Pool road holds a black standing pool; carts have cut a muddy braid round its east side. Within 120 ft the pines close over the road in a dark tunnel.
Water-bar
objects.desc: A half-buried log set across the climbing road to shed runoff, a fan of washed gravel below it.

objects.label: The Ravenloft road clings to the slope: a bank on its uphill side, a 5-10 ft drop on the downhill side, half-buried logs across it every 50 ft (easy cover for a prone archer). It climbs about 25 ft across the map and nearly 600 ft to the Tser Falls bridge (H), about 6 road-miles, 2 hours on foot.
Old grave
objects.desc: A blank headstone sunk almost to the turf and leaning with the wind over a sunken hollow.

objects.label: Blank gravestone
objects.desc: A plain headstone with sharp cut edges and nothing carved on it, over a low mound.

objects.label: The grave apart
objects.desc: The eleventh stone stands alone in the corner under the yew, tilted toward the tree. A ring of turf round it has been cleared and a dried posy of yew sprigs lies at its foot.

objects.label: Open grave
objects.desc: A freshly dug grave with no stone: raw earth walls, the spoil heaped on its north side with a rusted shovel standing in it. It is empty.

objects.label: The yew
objects.desc: An ancient yew, black-green and hollow-boled, its twisted trunk five feet thick. Its roots have heaved the corner of the wall apart and spilled a run of stones. Ravens shift in its crown.

objects.label: Gravedigger's lean-to
objects.desc: A collapsed lean-to of poles and turf against the outside of the wall, its roof fallen in at one end. Under it: a mattock, a shovel with a split haft, a coil of rope and a bier of two poles with rotted cross-slats.

objects.label: Gravedigger's tools under the collapsed lean-to: mattock, shovel, rope and a bier. Digging a grave takes about an hour with them, twice that without.
The grave apart: Marya's lover (crypt 7, p.87). Suggested resting place of the Tarokka treasure if the 7 of Coins put it here.

The yew's hollow bole: room for a Small creature, and a rotted leather bundle wedged inside (Hidden Bundle, p.30, if it is to hold anything). A swarm of bats, one of Strahd's spies, roosts in it by day.
Hearth stone: soot and fish bones on its lee side. Someone camps here between the forks, out of the wind, and recently.

Terrain: the knoll gives +8 ft, the deck +13 ft. The stair is the only easy way up; the rock face is a DC 10 Athletics scramble. The cart spur and the rutted NW fork are difficult terrain for wheels and mounts.
East, down to the river: the arching stone bridge over the Ivlis, then the village of Barovia (E). The river's hiss carries up the slope on a still day.
North-west, down through the tree tunnel: the river and the Tser Pool encampment (G), 1.7 miles.
South-west, uphill: Tser Falls (H), then the Gates of Ravenloft and Vallaki.
The Hanged One (illusion)
objects.desc: A grey corpse hangs from the rope that was empty a moment ago, turning slowly in the wind until its dead eyes find you.
objects.dm: Reveal as the party leaves by any road: a creak behind them. One random character sees themself; the others see a Barovian they do not know. Real to sight and smell; it melts away to nothing if touched or moved (p.35-36). Hide it again afterward.

objects.label: Raven on the beam
objects.dm: Set dressing unless the day table gives result 11 (swarms of ravens or a wereraven). A wereraven keeps its distance and shadows the party 1d4 hours (p.32).

objects.label: Raven on the beam
objects.dm: Set dressing unless the day table gives result 11 (swarms of ravens or a wereraven). A wereraven keeps its distance and shadows the party 1d4 hours (p.32).

objects.label: Vistani lookout
objects.playerLabel: A seated traveller with a wineskin
objects.dm: Table result 7 by day (1d4+1 Vistani bandits plundering graves, p.32): this one keeps watch from the stairs while three dig. Not hostile unless provoked; they offer to guide for 100 gp, and wolves leave a guided party alone. One of the four carries 2d4 gems worth 50 gp each.

objects.label: Swarm of bats (Strahd's spy)
objects.dm: Once per day or night a spy checks on the party (p.29): roosting in the yew's hollow by day, wheeling over the knoll at dusk. Notice it with passive Perception against its Stealth; it flees, snatching a small item if confronted.

objects.label: Vistani grave-robber
objects.dm: Digging at the open grave and the nearest old stone with the lean-to's tools, pipe smoke and laughter in the fog (table 7, p.32). Not hostile unless provoked; guides for 100 gp.

objects.label: Vistani escort
objects.dm: If the party travels with Vistani there is no encounter check; the escorts turn onto the NW fork without a glance at the gallows and lead the way down to the camp (p.35).

objects.label: Wolf
objects.dm: Table result 13 by day or 11 by night: 3d6 wolves (p.33). Howls from the southern pines first, a few minutes to prepare; the pack comes out of the treeline and circles the graveyard wall, using the fog hollow east of it. They cannot be charmed or frightened.

rooms.name: Knoll crown
rooms.desc: The level crown of the knoll, eight feet above the junction: thin turf over lichened rock, open to the wind, the gallows standing on it. From here a gap in the trees to the north looks down the slope to the grey sheet of Tser Pool a mile and a half off, and to the north-north-east the castle's silhouette rides the treeline.
rooms.dm: The gallows stairs are the only easy way onto the platform. Night scenery: Vistani fires through the northern gap and the castle on the NNE skyline tell the party where they stand; use them to sell the choice the signpost offers. A Vistani lookout may sit on the stairs here with a wineskin (table 7, p.32).

rooms.name: Gallows platform
rooms.desc: The rotting ten-foot deck of the gallows, thirteen feet above the road. Two planks are gone, the trapdoor under the rope has a rusted bolt, and the beam above is grooved where ropes have run. The rope end swings a little above head height.
rooms.dm: Trapdoor: a Medium creature standing on it for the first time drops 5 ft onto the junk below and lands prone unless it makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. The Hanged One appears here as the party leaves (hidden figure on the rope). Ravens on the beam lift off when the stairs are climbed and settle again; one may be a wereraven of the Keepers of the Feather that shadows the party for 1d4 hours (p.32).
